rule: An official download entry is publishable only after the exact installer, install, cold launch, second launch, network, version, SHA-256, signing and rollback evidence pass together.
prohibited: AAB offered as a direct install
unsigned or test-signed artifact described as production-signed
download URL restored before every evidence field passes
desktop package invented for a Web/PWA-only product
temporaryDowngradeBoundary: A ZIP may remain an explicitly non-installable evidence archive, but it cannot satisfy or restore an official installer link.
